listing.name: OpenGTPS1 (Gran Turismo 2)
listing.summary: Windows Gran Turismo 2 project awaiting an upstream grant for its original code. Read the current licensing status; existing files and retained installations stay untouched.
listing.download_block_reason: The upstream README states that no license has been granted for original OpenGTPS1 code. The existing canonical permission hold remains: an attributable grant for that code and a reviewed usable player/setup route are required before Portcove can offer acquisition. Licenses of vendored components do not grant rights to the whole project.

steps.title: Read the upstream licensing status
steps.instruction: The existing original-code permission hold is unresolved, and the current public GitHub release list is empty. Upstream’s older download references do not establish a current permitted player. Follow the linked licensing statement for changes; a future attributable grant and usable reviewed runtime/setup route can reopen acquisition review. This listing does not ask you to download or run a tool, or to remove an existing copy. Existing files, identity and retained installation contracts are preserved.
